items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Harold Peterson's sister, Lucille Peterson, was killed up in New Jersey... [INTERVIEWEE] They have another one. [INTERVIEWER] Lucille. [INTERVIEWEE] Imagine off and cycle with a band on there.

ctx.x: Harold Peterson's sister, Lucille Peterson, was killed up in New Jersey. She played with a girl's band. She had gold saxophone. And then his other sister, May Seal, she played with an orchestra and my sister played called Shades of Blue when they were young.
